Keywords: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa
RagShortTexts: In 1212 at Las Navas de Tolosa, Iberian Christian armies shattered Almohad supremacy,.

Variants.Content: On July 16, 1212, Las Navas de Tolosa fundamentally altered the destiny of Spain. Guided by a local shepherd across hidden Sierra Morena defiles, Alfonso VIII of Castile, backed by Navarre and Aragon, overwhelmed Caliph Muhammad al-Nasir's fortified tent encampment.
Sancho VII of Navarre shattered the chained Moorish bodyguard ring, initiating the rapid collapse of Almohad power in Andalusia.
